sources_quoted.quote: Active: Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected Dark Spheres, each dealing magic damage upon hit.

sources_quoted.quote: Magic Damage per Sphere = 80/120/160 (+20% AP); Minimum Magic Damage = 240/360/480 (+60% AP); Maximum Magic Damage = 560/840/1120 (+140% AP)

Active: Syndra propels a wave of force in a cone in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit and knocks them back for 400 units and up to 800 units away from Syndra based on proximity, though not through terrain.

Dark Spheres can be knocked back for 950 units and up to 1200 units away from Syndra based on proximity, knocking back enemies they hit over 70 units, though not through terrain. Targets hit are also stunned for 1.25 seconds, during which they are also revealed, and dealt Scatter the Weak's damage if they were not damaged by the initial cast.

Collecting 80 Splinters of Wrath enhances Scatter the Weak to have an increased scatter angle and slow enemies hit by 70% for 1.25 seconds starting after the knock back ends or if the target was hit by a pushed Dark Sphere, after the stun has ended.

Recast: Syndra throws the grabbed target towards the target location, granting sight of their surroundings as they fall and dealing magic damage to them and nearby enemies once they land. All targets hit are slowed by 25% for 1.5 seconds.
Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.
Active: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location that appears after a 0.6-second delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.

step_1_sphere_arithmetic_confirms_R_is_a.wiki_text: R conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones (3 <= spheres <= 7).
step_1_sphere_arithmetic_confirms_R_is_a.check_minimum: 3 spheres x (80/120/160) = 240/360/480 == cached 'Minimum Magic Damage' 240/360/480; 3 x 20% AP = 60% AP == cached +60% AP. MATCH.
step_1_sphere_arithmetic_confirms_R_is_a.check_maximum: (3+4)=7 spheres x (80/120/160) = 560/840/1120 == cached 'Maximum Magic Damage' 560/840/1120; 7 x 20% AP = 140% AP == cached +140% AP. MATCH.
step_1_sphere_arithmetic_confirms_R_is_a.conclusion: The cached leveling attribute is literally named 'Magic Damage per Sphere', and the min/max rows are exactly 3x and 7x it. R's damage is strictly increasing in the number of live Dark Spheres already on the field, which are produced by the earlier Q/W casts. Therefore R is the cast that must come last in a burst rotation ('closes the burst'): casting it earlier forfeits up to 4/7 of its output. The old value's two factual claims - the per-sphere magic-damage attribute and R-terminates-the-burst - are both derivable from the cached wiki text alone.

step_2_new_value_names_no_crowd_control_.finding: 'cc_kind' is a schema/marker identifier, not a crowd-control type. It appears in the audit corpus as a field name ('cc_kind marker on E' for Ahri), and it is absent from the CC vocabulary in data/wiki-atoms/crowd-control-mobility.json, whose kinds are named values (airborne/knock back, stun, slow, cripple, disarm, ...).
step_2_new_value_names_no_crowd_control_.what_the_wiki_actually_says: Syndra E applies (a) a knock back of 400-800 units on the initial cone, (b) a 1.25 s stun on targets hit by a knocked-back Dark Sphere, and (c) at 80 Splinters only, a 70% slow for 1.25 s.
step_2_new_value_names_no_crowd_control_.conclusion: A source line reading 'E applies cc_kind crowd control' asserts nothing that the cached wiki text supports - it renders a field key where the value ('knock back'/'stun') belongs. As an evidence string it is unsourced.

step_3_the_ordering_claim_inverts_the_wi.wiki_dependency: E's stun is conditional on a Dark Sphere being available to knock back ('Dark Spheres can be knocked back ... Targets hit are also stunned for 1.25 seconds'). Spheres are supplied by Q (0.6 s delay, 6 s lifetime) and relocated to the target by W ('throws the grabbed target towards the target location ... if a Dark Sphere is grabbed, its duration is refreshed').
step_3_the_ordering_claim_inverts_the_wi.conclusion: W is precisely the cast that delivers a live sphere to the target's location, so E's strongest CC is enabled by W rather than being 'setup before W'. The new value states the dependency backwards.
step_3_the_ordering_claim_inverts_the_wi.scenario_number_check: The scenario is pinned at 60 Splinters of Wrath. The Transcendent thresholds are Q 40, W 60, E 80, R 100 (and Transcendence at 120). At exactly 60 splinters the newly unlocked bonus belongs to W (12% (+2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage); E's enhancement does not exist yet at this stack count, which further undercuts an E-centric rationale line for this specific scenario.

independent_computation.residual_nit_on_the_old_value: The old string quotes 'Magic Damage' and leaves 'per sphere' outside the quotes, whereas the cached leveling attribute is spelled 'Magic Damage per Sphere' (R has no bare 'Magic Damage' attribute; Q/W/E do). The quantity designated is nevertheless the correct one, so this is a formatting blemish, not a factual error - not enough to move the verdict to both_wrong.

verdict_rationale: The old value is fully corroborated by the cached wiki text and by exact 3x/7x arithmetic on R's per-sphere leveling row; the new value substitutes an unresolved schema key ('cc_kind') for a crowd-control type that the wiki names concretely, and asserts an E-before-W setup ordering that inverts the sphere dependency the wiki describes and is off-point for the 60-splinter (W-enhancement) scenario. Retiring the old leaf in favour of the new one is a regression.
